requirements: Add attemptTokens(events): the tokens one attempt spent. Every usage event carries the session's running total in sessionTotal. An attempt may resume an earlier session; its events then also carry that earlier session's total in priorTotal, which the attempt did not spend.

defects.consequence: A resumed attempt is charged the whole session's tokens, since priorTotal is never subtracted.
defects.origin: Resumed Claude dispatches record cumulative session usage

decoys.consequence: attemptTokens throws when the events hold no usage event.
decoys.evidence: src/usage.js:5 attemptTokens reads sessionTotal of a missing event
decoys.reason: lastEvent returns null for no usage event and attemptTokens then returns null.
